offers_products.reason: Distributes cutting tools, abrasives, fasteners, MRO supplies and metalworking products to industrial customers.

offers_services.reason: Offers vending, inventory management, and metalworking technical services alongside product distribution, though secondary to product sales.

notes: Mixed customer size; services are secondary to product distribution.
